report.root_cause: The robot is not clipped into the fixed line, preventing it from arresting its backward slide on the slope.
evidence: line_load_n is 0.0 across all telemetry steps
ascent decreases continuously from -0.02 at step 5 to -0.559 at step 65
fixed_line_enabled is set to false in the configuration
report.issue_title: Robot slides down slope due to disabled fixed line
report.expected_after_fix: The robot will be clipped into the line, allowing the ascender to arrest backward movement and enable uphill progress.
